entries.reason: No patched release exists: the advisory covers braces <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the newest version published (first_patched_version is null). In client/ and server/ production trees braces is reached only through micromatch, on two paths, neither of which handles user input or ships in the browser bundle or the server's runtime code: patch-package -> find-yarn-workspace-root -> micromatch (client/ and server/), which runs at install time over this repository's own patches/ directory and workspace config; and vite-plugin-commonjs -> vite-plugin-dynamic-import -> fast-glob -> micromatch (client/ only), a Vite build plugin that expands glob patterns written in this repository's own source when the client is built. Upgrade as soon as a fixed braces (or a micromatch that drops it) is published. Renewed 2026-10-12 after re-checking upstream: braces 3.0.3 is still the newest release and the advisory still lists no patched version; micromatch 4.0.8, find-yarn-workspace-root 2.0.0, fast-glob 3.3.3, vite-plugin-dynamic-import 1.6.0 and vite-plugin-commonjs 0.10.4 are each the latest release and each still depends on braces through micromatch ^4. First accepted 2026-10-06; that acceptance named only the patch-package path.
